sloka: यानैश्च शकटैश्चैव हयैर्नागैश्च सा चमू: ।पुनर्निवृत्ता विस्तीर्णा भरतस्यानुयायिनी ॥ २.११३.२०॥
transliteration: yānaiśca śakaṭaiścaiva hayairnāgaiśca sā camū: ।punarnivṛttā vistīrṇā bharatasyānuyāyinī ॥ 2.113.20॥

translations.english: The vast army of Bharata with all its carriages, carts, horses and elephants following him again turned back towards Ayodhya.
